claims.claim_text: Legacy FFX structure atlas (2026-08-17 snapshot), section 11.33 (Magic EgoVM opcode mapping): Lane: PURE RESEARCH | Status: research only (no editor changes) Source: FFX.exe g_FFX_MagicOpcodeTable_core @ 0xC48EC8, 256 slots, 137 non-null Editor: FFXProjectEditor/FfxLib/Magic/EgoVmOpcode.cs, 39 opcodes with handler.
claims.notes: DRAFT y5 candidate — NOT accepted; pending X/Y/Z review cycle

claims.claim_text: Legacy FFX structure atlas (2026-08-17 snapshot), section 11.33 (Magic EgoVM opcode mapping): The FFX.exe PC magic runtime dispatches EgoVM (Timeline VM) opcodes from a 256-entry table at 0xC48EC8. Of 256 slots, 137 are non-null (active handlers). The editor currently covers 39/137 (28%). The remaining 98 opcodes have real handlers in the runtime but are not wired in the editor EgoVmOpcodeTable.GetMetadata.
